title: Executive
qualification: All prescribed qualifications must be with First Class (60% marks in aggregate) for UR/OBC(NCL)/EWS candidates and 55% marks in aggregate for SC/ST candidates. This requirement does not apply to qualified CAs/CMAs/CSs. || Courses must be full-time/regular and recognized by the State/Central Government/UGC/AICTE, as applicable. || For non-technical posts, qualifications via Online/Distance Learning from recognized universities/institutions are also considered, subject to conditions. || If a course does not indicate percentage/first class, a conversion certificate from the university is required; in its absence, a minimum of 6 on a 10-point scale will be treated as 60%.
salary: In addition to CTC, Performance Related Pay (annual) will be provided as per rules. The Senior Manager (Medical), E-4 post also carries Non-Practicing Allowance, currently 20% of Basic Pay. Besides Basic Pay, candidates are entitled to Dearness Allowance, HRA/Company accommodation, perks, annual increments, leave encashment, medical facilities, Group Term Life Insurance, loans and advances, PF, Gratuity, Pension Scheme, Post-Retirement Medical Scheme (PRMS), and uniforms, as per company rules. Candidates from State/Central Government/Semi-Government/Autonomous Bodies/PSUs are eligible for pay protection as per applicable rules.
age_limit: The upper age limit varies by post and grade, as detailed in the vacancy table above (ranging from 28 years for Assistant Manager posts to 50 years for General Manager). Age relaxation applicable: || In any case, the upper age (including all relaxations) shall not exceed 56 years.
application_fee: Fee must be paid online via Debit/Credit Card, Net Banking, Wallets, or UPI. The application fee is non-refundable under any circumstances, and once paid cannot be adjusted against any other recruitment.
selection_process: Shortlisting is based on information/declaration submitted in the online application, verified later against uploaded documents. || Candidates with experience in Mining, Metallurgical, Chemical, Power, or Manufacturing/Production sectors will have an advantage. || Assessment is through Personal Interview/Psychometric Test/Group Exercise, or a combination. Multiple levels of interview may be conducted if the number of shortlisted candidates is high. || The company reserves the right to conduct a written test or any other test if required. || Meeting the advertised eligibility criteria does not by itself entitle a candidate to be called for interview. || Selection depends on interview performance, organizational requirement, and vacancy availability. || Selected candidates must clear a Pre-Employment Medical Examination and Character & Antecedents Verification before joining. A reasonable wait-list will be maintained for one year.
